selection.method: Uniform random sample of 5 distinct template IDs without replacement. Plan five distinct angles after selection. Recent-template avoidance is an optional explicitly different distribution.
selection.fallback: Preserve completed images. Exclude blocked template for this run and randomly draw one unused template. Fill the missing emotional angle. Never obscure or rephrase blocked content to evade safeguards. Obey attempt and cost limits.
selection.generation: Before generating, plan all five memes as a coordinated storyboard. Distinct emotion, project hook, subject, payoff and scene for each. Review semantic repetition. One image per selected template, exact token artwork, verified narrative, distinct caption candidates.
selection.logging: Retain initial draw, successful template IDs and any replacements.

templates.name: Drake Hotline Bling
templates.layout: Two vertically stacked responses; label rejected option and chosen option.
templates.pitfall: Avoid turning both panels into generic buy copy.

templates.name: Two Buttons
templates.layout: Two buttons above a sweating decision-maker.
templates.pitfall: Each button must represent a conflicting action.

templates.name: Distracted Boyfriend
templates.layout: Label boyfriend, existing interest and new temptation.
templates.pitfall: The distraction must be specific to this narrative.

templates.name: Always Has Been
templates.layout: First astronaut asks; second astronaut reveals that it was always true.
templates.pitfall: Keep the reveal self-evident and absurd, not invented token history.

templates.name: Disaster Girl
templates.layout: Smirking girl foreground, chaos in background.
templates.pitfall: Use fictional trader chaos; do not imply real-world wrongdoing by the project.

templates.name: Change My Mind
templates.layout: Seated speaker with one short challenge on the sign.
templates.pitfall: Do not duplicate Stonks-style research if Stonks is in the same pack.

templates.name: Buff Doge vs. Cheems
templates.layout: Two side-by-side characters with sharply different status.
templates.pitfall: Match both labels to one clear comparison.

templates.name: This Is Fine
templates.layout: Dog calmly seated while surroundings contradict its assurance.
templates.pitfall: The surroundings must explain the denial.

templates.name: Surprised Pikachu
templates.layout: Setup followed by shocked reaction.
templates.pitfall: Surprise alone is not a joke; the result must follow from the setup.

templates.name: Leonardo Dicaprio Cheers
templates.layout: Gatsby raises a glass toward the viewer.
templates.pitfall: Use a knowing toast, not a generic congratulations banner.

templates.name: Trump Bill Signing
templates.layout: Recognizable seated figure holding an open document.
templates.pitfall: The document is a joke; never imply a real endorsement.

templates.name: Smug Pepe
templates.layout: Smiling green frog in a scene that demonstrates confidence.
templates.pitfall: Find a different reason for certainty than the other four jokes.

templates.name: Gigachad
templates.layout: Recognizable monochrome confident face with a terse exchange.
templates.pitfall: Short punchline; no motivational monologue.

templates.name: Stonks
templates.layout: Meme Man, market board and arrow; identify the ridiculous research input.
templates.pitfall: Generic green charts alone are insufficient.

templates.name: Pink Wojak
templates.layout: Recognizable crying Wojak; original reference is white, pink stylization optional.
templates.pitfall: Regret must have a distinct cause, not repeat another meme’s FUD premise.

templates.name: Bernie I Am Once Again Asking For Your Support
templates.layout: Bernie outdoors addressing viewer with a plea.
templates.pitfall: Complete the recurring opening with one project-specific request.

templates.name: Anakin Padme 4 Panel
templates.layout: Four panels: assertion, reassuring question, silence, concerned repetition.
templates.pitfall: Silence in panel three makes the joke; do not over-explain it.

templates.name: Gru's Plan
templates.layout: Four panels; steps one and two, unforeseen consequence, shocked rereading.
templates.pitfall: Third and fourth panels repeat the consequence; this is intentional within one template.

templates.name: Waiting Skeleton
templates.layout: Skeleton on bench, one short statement of what it is waiting for.
templates.pitfall: Do not invent missed project deadlines; joke about fictional trader waiting.

templates.name: Trade Offer
templates.layout: Offer heading, I receive left, you receive right, suited man below.
templates.pitfall: Keep it a fictional exchange or metaphor, not a real commercial promise.

templates.name: Woman Yelling At Cat
templates.layout: Accusatory woman left, baffled cat right.
templates.pitfall: The cat must misread or puncture the accusation.

templates.name: Expanding Brain
templates.layout: Four rows: ordinary reasoning escalates into cosmic nonsense.
templates.pitfall: The final row must subvert the apparent intelligence hierarchy.

templates.name: Clown Applying Makeup
templates.layout: Four stages from ordinary face to full clown.
templates.pitfall: Each justification must get less credible; avoid repeating one sentence four times.

templates.name: Roll Safe Think About It
templates.layout: Man tapping his temple, satisfied with his own bad reasoning.
templates.pitfall: Use a flawed logical shortcut, not another due-diligence gag.

templates.name: Hide the Pain Harold
templates.layout: Smiling older man with laptop and mug.
templates.pitfall: External reassurance must clash with a specific internal worry.

test_run.revision: Five distinct angles: FUD immunity, screen compulsion, chat bravado, wishful thinking and absurd research.

pack_design.required_step: Plan all five memes together before making any image. Assign a different emotion, subject and punchline mechanism to each.
uniqueness_check: Different wording alone does not make a different joke. Reject repeated premises, emotional beats, project hooks and conclusions.
If two captions can be swapped between their images without weakening either joke, rewrite them.
Use different parts of the project narrative across the pack, not the same keyword five times.
Use each main community catchphrase at most once in a pack. Logo and ticker repetition are allowed.
Do not put the same activity, prop or slogan at the center of all five scenes.
Respect the native joke of each template: reaction, contrast, contradiction, dilemma or confident absurdity.
Review the complete five-item storyboard, then generate. Replacements must fill the missing emotional angle.
pack_design.visual_rule: Retain the polish of the approved Pumptober pack. Let context affect each scene, action and expression. A badge or logo alone is not enough.

popularity_basis.description: Curated recognizable classics, not a verified universal or crypto-specific top-25 ranking. The ten additions all appeared in Imgflip get_memes popular-template snapshot on 2026-09-29. Snapshot positions are provider ordering, not cross-platform audience percentages.
